user.title: Connect to BirdNET-Go
user.description: Set up a server-side Audubon clock: hour→bird assignment and the on-the-hour chime run inside Home Assistant, independent of the Bird Card dashboard - the card isn't required.

data.api_token: API token (only needed if BirdNET-Go's Private Mode is enabled)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BirdNET-Go at this URL. Check the address and that BirdNET-Go is running.

abort.already_configured: This BirdNET-Go server is already configured.

init.title: Audubon clock options
init.description: Chimes are off unless both a Xeno-Canto key and at least one chime media player are set below (the 'Chime enabled' switch can still pause them without clearing these). If you also enable clock_chime in the Bird Card, turn it off there to avoid chiming twice.

data.chime_media_players: Chime media players (plays on all of them at once)
data.chime_max_seconds: Cut chime playback after (seconds, 0 = full length)
data.hour_pins: Pinned hour -> species, as a JSON object (e.g. pin hour 7 to Turdus migratorius)

error.invalid_pins: Hour pins must be valid JSON mapping a clock position to a scientific name.
